info.name: I425-G7 Mario Kart 8 API (Lab 3)
info.description:
Start the API with: uvicorn main:app --reload
Run the folders in order. 'Create, Update, Delete' passes the new IDs between requests automatically. 'Validation and Errors' shows requests that are rejected.
